description: This file defines a feature for adding a follower relationship between users in a social media or blogging platform. It includes a command to add a follow, validation for the command, and a request handler that processes the follow request by updating the database and returning the profile of the followed user.

classes.name: Add.Command
classes.description: A record representing the command to add a follower by username.

classes.name: Add.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validator class ensuring the username is not null or empty.

classes.name: Add.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the command to add a follower, interacts with database context, and returns a profile envelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronous method that processes the follow request, updates the database, and returns the followed user's profile.
